activity.overview: Describe likelihood with words and numbers, and find theoretical probabilities.

problems.prompt: Describe each event as impossible, unlikely, equally likely, likely or certain: (a) rolling a 7 on a standard number cube, (b) flipping a coin and getting heads, (c) picking a red marble from a bag of 9 red marbles and 1 blue marble.
A spinner has 8 equal sections: 3 green, 4 yellow and 1 purple. Find P(green), P(yellow) and P(purple).
A standard number cube is rolled once. What is the probability of rolling a number greater than 4?
Which event is more likely: one with probability 0.35 or one with probability 2/5? Explain.
A bag has 4 red, 6 blue and 10 white tiles. What is the probability of picking a tile that is not white?

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: How Likely Is It?
